lines.en: I slide past the edge of the screen.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓闪了一下又稳
lines.en: My outline flickers and steadies.
I flash at the end of the hall.
I fade after two steps.
I move along the wall.
I step out through the mirror.
My shadow lags behind me.
I flit past the corner.
I walk and stop, walk and stop.
Not even the air moves as I come.

lines.zh: 我从你的视线边缘过去
lines.en: I pass at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我又出现在另一个方向
lines.en: I appear in another direction.
The me you see isn't real.
My eyes never stop watching.

lines.zh: 我半透明的身体发着暗光
lines.en: My translucent body gives dim light.
The corner of my mouth does not move.

lines.zh: 我在等你回头，幻象已经站好了。
lines.en: I wait for you to turn; the illusion is in place.

lines.zh: 幻影不会留下一点声音。
lines.en: An illusion leaves not a single sound.
I lift one half-seen hand.
My colour fades a shade.
I stop in the middle of the view.
I appear once more.
I watch the back of your neck.
I do not breathe.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓抖了一下，走廊尽头一闪。
lines.en: My outline shudders and flickers at the corridor's end.
I stay standing there.
I look straight at you.
What you see of me may not be here.
I might not be real.
The angle of my head is all wrong.
My mouth is stretched too wide.
I have been behind you already.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是看见我了
lines.en: Did you just see me?
I flicker again.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的功夫我就不在了
lines.en: Blink and I am gone.
The picture goes quiet when I smile.
I am one block from you.

lines.zh: 你想确信我是不是真的吗
lines.en: Do you want to be sure I am real?
My eyes have no pupils.

lines.zh: 我从你左边的空气里显形
lines.en: I form out of the air on your left.
Did you hear someone call you?

lines.zh: 你旁边一直站着一个我
lines.en: A me has always stood beside you.
We have met a few times, really.

lines.zh: 我不会一直让你看见我
lines.en: I will not let you keep seeing me.
You could try recording me.
My shadow is under your feet.
My body scatters.
My outline shakes badly.
I slowly re-form.
Not a whisper comes from me.
The view flickers harder.
My colour fades a degree.
I retreat to the wall.

lines.zh: 你看见的我，不一定是真的。
lines.en: What you see of me may not be real.
I am still there before you.
This body wavers and dims.
You hold that thing up.
There is nothing I want.
I pass through it.
That has no effect on me.
You cannot catch me.
I flicker to the other side.
I didn't even turn my eyes.
That thing is not real.
I am less real than it is.
I vanish for a while.
You hit me and I scatter.
I gather back together.
You plunge into me and out.
My shadow flickers.
You touched something very cold.
I did not feel a thing.
I drift half a block back.
What you caught is air.
I am back where I was.
You lunge through me into the wall.
Another seeps out of the wall.
The two of us hang in a row.
Its outline is fainter than mine.
Our necks tilt at the same instant.
Our shadows overlap as one.
We both turn to you.
We do not speak.
It fades first.
I fade after it.
We appear in the same place.
Something falls at my feet.
It passes through my hand.

lines.zh: 我的手从东西里穿过去
lines.en: My hand passes straight through it.
I watch it move by itself.
A gesture lifts it into the air.
I flatten my hand and it drops.
It grows very cold.
It has no shadow at my feet.
I did not touch it.
I leave it hanging in the air.

lines.zh: 我的脸转向了你的方向
lines.en: My face turns toward where you are.
My outline sharpens a little.
The view begins to flicker.
I have your position.
The sound around you has changed.
I lean toward you.
I do not mean to vanish this time.
I slide to the edge of your sight.
My eyes go fixed.
Turn around and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我的手抬到和眼一样高
lines.en: I raise my hand to eye level.
The air is turning cold.
I form beside you.
I mean to let you see clearly.
That face of mine grins wider.
When you turn, I'll be right there.
I stay outside your sight.
You turn, and I move.
I erase myself from the view.
My shadow touches your feet.

lines.zh: 看见我的那一眼，是假的。
lines.en: The moment you saw me was false.
Two steps from you, two from me.
I waver bright and dim.
Those footsteps are only an illusion.
No hurry; time is mine.

lines.zh: 你看的那一眼，是我造的。
lines.en: That glimpse you saw was mine.
Each time I appear closer.
You are beginning to doubt yourself.
I hang behind you.
I wait behind the wall at your turn.
I hold a hand above your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你听见的那个声音不是我
lines.en: That sound you hear is not me.
I appear right in front of you.
I do not mean to let you see clearly.
Something is in the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 我比这栋房子更早在这
lines.en: I was here before this house.
I reach for your throat.
My hand passes through.
A wave of dizziness hits you.
I bear down in your sight.
My face fills your vision.
I push you back a step.
My scream makes no sound.
Your ears begin to ring.
I strike once and scatter.
I re-form somewhere else.
My hand is on your back.
You spin around.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候画面跳了一下
lines.en: The view skips when I laugh.
I speak against the back of your neck.
Your swing caught only air.
I am back in your sight.
The screen flickers once.
I form out of the noise.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓先出现在墙上
lines.en: My outline shows on the wall first.
The air turns suddenly cold.
I stand in the corner of your eye.
At first I am only a pair of eyes.
I slowly take shape.
A new shadow in the view.

lines.zh: 我的声音像是被掐住了
lines.en: My voice sounds choked.

lines.zh: 我从墙上的裂口渗出来
lines.en: I seep out of the crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 我站在那个本不该有人的地方
lines.en: I stand where no one should be.
The shadow spreads out first.
I look through from the mirror's side.

lines.zh: 你转头的时候我就在了
lines.en: I was there when you turned.
I begin to smile at you.
My hand comes out of the wall.
I have waited here a moment.
I do not know if I am real.

lines.zh: 我出现的地方总是错位
lines.en: Where I appear is always wrong.
You cannot make out my face.
The firelight fades me.
I drop out of the view.

lines.zh: 幻象被水穿过去，纹丝不动。
lines.en: Water passes through the illusion; it does not stir.
The blast scatters my form.

lines.zh: 我只是个影子，看得见摸不着。
lines.en: Only a shadow. Seen, not touched.
Spell light tears my outline.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只是淡了
lines.en: I never eat; I only fade.
Lightning shows me too clearly.

lines.zh: 你看见的我，只是影子做的。
lines.en: What you see is only made of shadow.
